it: Sono un full-stack developer con base a Trieste. Appassionato di grafica 3D e web visualization, lavoro principalmente con React, Three.js e TypeScript. Mi piace esplorare nuove tecnologie e contribuire all'open source.
en: I'm a full-stack developer based in Trieste, Italy. Passionate about 3D graphics and web visualization, I mainly work with React, Three.js, and TypeScript. I love exploring new technologies and contributing to open source.
